name: Scrutiny S.M.A.R.T Disk Health Monitoring (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted disk health dashboard with S.M.A.R.T metrics, historical trends and disk failure thresholds; no vendor software license fee or usage quota.
watch_out: Requires a server with disk S.M.A.R.T access and a self-operated collector/web application; device or privileged Docker access can have security implications. Storage, backup and server costs are not included; monitoring is not a substitute for backups.
